studios

We build tools at the intersection of wellness, sound, and embodiment.

Small, intentional apps — often experimental — that explore how technology can support nervous system regulation, creative flow, and deeper presence.

— focus areas
  • 01Somatic tools that encourage breath, awareness, and stillnesssomatic

— philosophy

we don't chase scale.
we build for feeling.

Each project reflects a commitment to slowness, simplicity, and intuitive design — shaped by our roots in creative coding, music, and embodied experience.
